mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, it is a clear 52 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School with the moon currently in its third quarter phase.

October is officially Community Planning Month, a time to honor our planning department for their work on housing and land use, while the city also reminds residents that the Fireman's Park beach is now closed for the season.

Today is packed with activities, including live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, as well as the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival, with more fun coming tomorrow like yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a noteworthy call from September 21, police identified and cited a suspect for the retail theft of Swedish Fish candy after reviewing surveillance footage.
Today's flavor is the fan favorite Andes Mint Avalanche, and the restaurant will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
